payload.core_mechanism_summary: Transforms bounded knapsack with unlimited plain buns into 0-1 knapsack by creating individual items, then uses a 2D DP array (item index × remaining dough) to compute max profit, finally adding plain bun profit from remaining dough.
payload.rationale: The solution explicitly builds a 2D DP table where state is defined by which items have been considered and the amount of dough left. This matches a 2D state DP pattern, specifically a knapsack variant.
